page.title: Receipt vouchers
page.sub: Collections allocated to invoices; the remaining amount is computed from allocations, not a stored field
page.search: Search by voucher number, customer or reference...
page.reverse_body: Issue a reversing voucher for {{no}} of {{amount}}? An opposite entry will be posted and the allocated invoices return to their previous state. The original voucher stays on record.

modal.err_required: A customer and a positive amount are required.
modal.err_bank: Choose the bank account for the transfer.
modal.err_over: Total allocations exceed the voucher amount.
modal.err_declare: The voucher has {{amount}} above the allocated amount. Declare what it is: an advance payment (a 386 invoice is issued for it now) or an amount on account.
modal.err_prepayment_tax: An advance payment carries the category of what it pays for. Choose it (standard rated, zero rated with reason, exempt with reason, out of scope with reason); it is declared, never assumed.
modal.title: New receipt voucher
modal.card_account: Card network receivables (1251) until the acquirer transfers them; they reach the bank through "Card network settlements"
modal.allocate_title: Allocate the voucher to open invoices
modal.other_currency_excluded: Open invoices not shown here because they are in a currency other than {{currency}}, the voucher currency: {{n}}
modal.no_open: No open invoices for this customer. Money received before supply is an advance payment, with a 386 invoice issued on the voucher date
modal.fate_legend: What is the {{amount}} above the allocated amount?
modal.fate_prepayment: Advance payment: an advance payment invoice (386) is issued on the voucher date and deducted from the supply invoice later
modal.fate_on_account: On account: allocated later to existing open invoices that cover it
modal.prepayment_category: Category of what is paid in advance; declared, never assumed (exempt residential rent · standard rated service · …)
